pool.text: Hurghada was officially established as a city.
Oil discovered in Hurghada area by Anglo-Egyptian Oilfields Ltd.
Israeli helicopter assault occupied Shadwan Island for 36 hours.
Hurghada harbor targeted in four Israeli operations during October War.
Drive‑by shooters killed two Egyptians and a German tourist near Hurghada.
Kempinski hotel opened in Soma Bay resort near Hurghada.
Hurghada Grand Aquarium opened, becoming Egypt's largest aquarium.
Islamic State‑inspired terrorist attack wounded three tourists in Hurghada.
Stabbing attack targeted non‑Egyptian female tourists, seven injured.
Hurghada attracts over 9 million visitors annually, ranking among top world tourist cities.
